_about: Settings for isotopia_py/xs_uncertainty.py. Keys starting with '_' are comments. See docs/xs_uncertainty.md, section 'Inputs you must give'.
_tendl_relative: USER INPUT 1. Default 1-sigma relative uncertainty (0.30 = 30%) of a TENDL (model-only) cross section, and of IAEA files outside their evaluated range. null = not chosen yet: those channels add nothing and results are flagged LOWER BOUND.
_energy_correlation: Correlation between the energies of one channel: 'full' (cautious default), 'none' (diagnostic only) or 'exponential' with correlation_length in MeV.
_channel_correlation: USER INPUT 2. Correlation between different channels, 0 (independent) to 1.
_comparison_sigma: USER INPUT 3. Route A beats route B when ln(N_A/N_B) is larger than this many standard deviations; otherwise they tie.
_numerics: Finite-difference step for sensitivities, and the allowed mismatch between the rebuilt rate and the port's rate.
